comparison.objective: Safely rout a curved board edge using a starting pin and bearing; candidate separates mixed finishing media and workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained board pivoting and directional feed around a powered cutter versus bimanual load sharing, controlled screen orientation and particle passage through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Specified routed length, safe cutter approach, correct feed direction and board clearance versus media recovery, washer retention, spill prevention, screen support and released dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve controlled motion, but routing tests hazard-aware workpiece feeding against a cutter rather than physical size separation of loose bodies.
